svg.title: Hey, I'm Saúl Romero
svg.desc: Full-stack web developer with a focus on cloud technologies. I build Vue and Nuxt interfaces, Laravel and Node back ends, and ship them to AWS. Now · Professional Residency: Frontend Developer at Alebat Education, Nuxt e-commerce · Remote with Spain. Studying: Computer Systems Engineering, Instituto Tecnológico de Morelia. Based in: Morelia, México, UTC−6, Central Time.
